title: Issi ben Shammai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mekhilta, Beshalach, [Massekhta deShirah, chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Shirah.2.26), and there, [Massekhta deVayassa, end of chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Vayassa.4.18). The Gra reads Issi ben Yehudah, as cited in [Yoma 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.76a.9).

notes.text: The linked Shirah Hebrew names Issi ben Shammai, while its English has Issi ben Yehudah. Hyman’s Vayassa locator is the end of chapter 3, also cited in [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=447&lang=en) with Assi ben Shammai. The linked parallel is numbered 4:18 and reads Asei ben Akubah in Hebrew and Issi ben Yehudah in English. Yoma names Issi ben Yehudah in its parallel about the manna. The exact Gra apparatus remains uncollated.
